```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(broom)
library(corrplot)
library(NHANES)

data(NHANES)

# Adults 18-80 with complete data on the lab variables
nhanes_adult <- NHANES |>
  filter(Age >= 18, Age <= 80) |>
  select(Age, Weight, Height, BMI, BPSysAve, BPDiaAve,
         Pulse, PhysActive, SleepHrsNight) |>
  na.omit()
```
